breakdown.description: Inviscid flow assumptions are incompatible with the no-slip condition
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that an inviscid fluid is incompatible with a no-slip condition. It resolved this by changing the fluid property from 'inviscid' to 'viscous', which aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.

breakdown.description: No-slip condition requires viscosity to generate shear stress at the wall
